title: Agent 306 Skill Card
description: Canonical machine-readable safety envelope for a registered Agent 306 internal skill. The propose-only contract REQUIRES that every registered card sets policy.propose_only=true, policy.expands_autonomy=false, read_only=true, every writes.* false, and promotion_authority="none". The validator (scripts/validateSkillCards.ts) refuses to accept any other shape. This document is the documented shape; the runtime authority is the Zod schema at server/skillGovernance/skillCardSchema.ts.

id.description: Slug-style identifier. Must match the parent directory name (skills/<id>/SKILLCARD.yaml) and the matching registry entry.

version.description: Semver-ish version pin. Free-form string at this layer; CI is the source of truth.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of what the skill does and what it explicitly does NOT do.

policy.description: Declared policy envelope. The validator REQUIRES propose_only=true and expands_autonomy=false.

read_only.description: MUST be true. Registered skills do not mutate state.

writes.description: Declared write surfaces. EVERY field MUST be false. Adding new write keys is also rejected by the validator.

io_surfaces.description: Declared input/output surfaces. Informational; not used to grant authority.

promotion_authority.description: MUST be the literal string "none". No registered skill is allowed to drive promotion.

evidence.description: Repo-relative paths to evidence files (tests, workflow steps). The validator resolves each path against repo-root; entries containing a '#anchor' suffix have the suffix stripped before resolution (e.g. '.github/workflows/ci.yml#agent306-safety-gates').

tests.description: Repo-relative paths to test files that pin this skill's invariants. Every path MUST exist.
